about: Story boss encounters rebuilt from what the client holds (docs/systems/dungeon.md, 'Story encounters'). The original server's encounter scripts and boss behaviour trees (NPCConfig _iAISpecial MainStory_*) are not in the client. What is real: the boss and companion templates (NPCConfig), their skill kits (SkillConfig, named by _kScriptLogic), the skill timelines (data/skills, m_kShows effects and timings), the dialogue (ChatConfig 53xxxxx), the scene-editor points and the quest stages (DungeonQuestConfig). What is chosen here and marked as such: which skills a boss uses and in which order, every hit area and hit time, the stage triggers, the companions' rotations (except the priest, whose tree MainStory_MuShi ships) and when each line is said. An encounter with a 'source' was retimed from a capture of another private server (Genesis, which differs from the official beta); that source says which values it gave. Fields: 'airWalls' (scene-editor air walls raised for the run, var 133), a boss skill's 'fromStage', an ally's 'ms' (arrival after its stage starts), a kit with no skills (a bystander the boss leaves alone), and a stage end's 'blackScreenMs', 'cast' and 'castMs' (the boss's self-cast after the end).

1022001.name: Payon Forest: Eddga
1022001.source: Genesis capture 2026-10-25 (one run; Genesis is a private server that differs from the official beta): the cast, its points and arrival times, which lines are said by whom and when, the stage-1 end (black screen, Eddga's self-buff), the skills Eddga used and the closing lines' timing. Hit areas, rotations and target choice are still chosen.
1022001.why: Scene 1022001 (sc_pay_fild10_001_pl01): boss point 20 (boss位置, NpcLevelPointRespawnConfig 5300001 Eddga), Wule at 21 (唔勒), Boya at 23 (保亚), two groups of six adventurer points 24 and 40 labelled 战 猎 奶 商 刺 法 (swordman, hunter, priest, merchant, thief, mage). Two DungeonQuestConfig stages: 1 'Cover Boya and Wule', 2 'Join the Adventurers and defeat Eddga'. The client has two sets of six story adventurers (5300007-09 + 5300070-72, and the '2' variants 5300073-78) and the fighting Wule/Boya templates 5300086/87 with their own skills. Genesis raised air wall 32 (dungeon var 133) for the whole run and brought in the non-fighting Boya 5300080 and Wule 5300081 (camp 3, no AI, no skills), not the fighting 5300086/87.

bossSkills.why: MainStory_HuWangSkill3, timeline 53004: Skill1_6 three times, fx_eddga_skill_groundflame_xuli at 2.83 s, mark groups at 0, 2.52 and 5.1 s: ground flames around Eddga. A 7 m circle at 2.9, 5.4 and 7.6 s, a third of the damage each (chosen). Genesis: first used 3 s into stage 2, not in stage 1.

MainStory_HuWangSkill5, timeline 53008 (10.35 s action, CD 40 s). Genesis: used once in stage 2, the player hit 4.57 s and 8.85 s into it. A 12 m circle around Eddga at those times, half the damage each (area chosen).

MainStory_HuWangSkill4, timeline 53005: fx_eddga_skill_impact_xuli at 1.67 s, fx_eddga_skill_impact 4 m in front (scale 2) and a camera shake at 3.33 s: the jump and landing. A 5 m circle centred 4 m in front at 3.33 s (chosen from that offset). Genesis: used in both stages, with line 5300007 each time.

MainStory_HuWangNormalAttack, timeline 53006: Eddga's second swing (CD 2 s, 1.066 s action, attack point 0.517 s); his other swing 5300101 is the template's normal attack. Genesis mixed the two in both stages. A 5 m, 90 degree cone at 0.517 s (area chosen).

1022001.bossSkillsLeftOut: 5300201, 5300301 and 5300701 are in the client's kit, but Genesis's Eddga never used them in the captured run.

5300080.why: Boya (保亚, name 10470000386): camp 3, no AI and no skills in NPCConfig. Genesis: stands at point 23 for the whole fight and only talks.

5300081.why: Wule (唔勒, name 10470000385): camp 3, no AI and no skills. Genesis: stands at point 21 and only talks.

5300007.why: MainStory_ZhanShi: AttackSword, then Provoke, Magnum Break, Bash. Order as Genesis's adventurers cast them.

5300008.why: MainStory_FaShi: Attack, then Cold, Lightning, Fire Bolt. Order as Genesis's adventurers cast them.

5300009.why: MainStory_MuShi: behaviour tree 10803 ships in the client: Blessing 5330501, Increase AGI 5330601, then Sanctuary 5330701 / Heal 5330801 on camp-1 allies below 95% HP. Genesis's priest also cast Safety Wall 5331301 (CD 5 s, 1.5 m); it is left out here (no ground protection against monsters).

5300075.why: MainStory_MuShi2: same priest kit and rules.

5300070.why: MainStory_LieRen: HunterAttack, then Wind Walker, Arrow Shower, Double Strafe. Order as Genesis's adventurers cast them.

5300071.why: MainStory_DaoZei: ThiefAttack, then Enchant Poison, Envenom, Sonic Blow. Order as Genesis's adventurers cast them.

5300072.why: MainStory_ShangRen: NormalAttack, then Power Thrust, Adrenaline Rush, Cart Revolution. Order as Genesis's adventurers cast them.

stages.why: 'Cover Boya and Wule'. Genesis: Boya and Wule stand by and the player holds Eddga alone; after 15 s the screen goes black for a second, the quest shows done (var 10003 [1,1]) and a second later Eddga roars a self-buff (5300901, SkillConfig _kBuff1: buff 5301001, permanent); stage 2 starts 2.5 s after the end.

end.why: Genesis: 15.3 s after entry, whatever Eddga's HP; he cannot fall before stage 2.

stages.why: 'Join the Adventurers and defeat Eddga'. Genesis: the swordman and priest arrive with the stage, the mage, hunter, thief and merchant 3.65 s later, then the six '2' adventurers 5.7 s in, each at its own point; the swordman draws Eddga first (chosen).
